name: MME-Emotion
description: MME-Emotion is a large-scale benchmark assessing emotional understanding and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models across diverse scenarios with over 6,000 video clips and task-specific QA pairs.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that is gaining attention in multimodal emotion understanding research, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Largest emotional intelligence benchmark for MLLMs; includes holistic evaluation suite and multi-agent analysis.
